intended_runtime_use: help the incident assistant generate concise first messages
support deterministic spatial reasoning before LLM summarization
support simulated outbound calls and messages during the demo

camera_context.camera_mount_description: Configured outdoor camera at the Gold Medal Equestrian / Rohan Ridge Ranch area.
camera_context.view_description: Wide rural view across dry grassland, ranch and equestrian facilities, scattered residences, vineyards/agricultural parcels, and distant hills.

primary_site_context.name: Gold Medal Equestrian
primary_site_context.role: customer site / equestrian facility / livestock-sensitive property
primary_site_context.published_business_description: Full-service equestrian business offering riding instruction and programs in eventing, dressage, and show jumping.
operational_relevance: Treat fire or dense smoke near barns, arenas, paddocks, trailers, hay/feed storage, access roads, or occupied ranch buildings as high sensitivity.
Horses and other animals may require earlier preparation and more time to relocate than people.
Smoke can create animal welfare, visibility, and evacuation-loading risks before flames reach structures.

scene_character.summary: A rural Central Coast landscape where equestrian operations, dry seasonal grass, agricultural parcels, vineyards, scattered homes, and winding local roads share the same fire environment.
dominant_exposure_types: hay, bedding, feed, fencing, and trailers
local road access and smoke visibility
scene_character.seasonal_note: The camera image shows dry grassland conditions. Treat fast-moving grass fire and wind-driven smoke as plausible operational scenarios.

nearby_operational_landmarks.name: Gold Medal Equestrian barns, arena, paddocks, and ranch buildings
nearby_operational_landmarks.recommended_action_hint: For detected fire or dense smoke near the facility, contact the site operator immediately and prepare animal relocation, trailer access, gate control, and responder access.

nearby_operational_landmarks.name: Farm House image zone
nearby_operational_landmarks.recommended_action_hint: Treat detections inside or moving toward this zone as a direct property and occupant notification case.

nearby_operational_landmarks.name: North Hill image zone
nearby_operational_landmarks.recommended_action_hint: A fire on the dry hillside may spread quickly through grass. Raise urgency when wind or slope carries risk toward ranch structures, homes, or roads.

nearby_operational_landmarks.name: Residence image zone
nearby_operational_landmarks.recommended_action_hint: Notify the relevant property contact when detected fire or smoke is near or moving toward occupied buildings.

nearby_operational_landmarks.name: Distant ridge and mountain zone
nearby_operational_landmarks.recommended_action_hint: Monitor and verify. Escalate when the plume grows, moves toward developed land, or affects access routes.

nearby_operational_landmarks.name: Concho Way and local ranch access roads
nearby_operational_landmarks.recommended_action_hint: Preserve access for fire apparatus and horse trailers. Escalate if smoke reduces visibility or fire threatens the only practical exit route.

nearby_operational_landmarks.name: Winifred Pifer Elementary School
nearby_operational_landmarks.recommended_action_hint: Use only when projected smoke or fire movement is plausibly toward the Creston Road school area. During school hours, recommend school or district notification through the official number.

nearby_operational_landmarks.name: Georgia Brown Dual Immersion
nearby_operational_landmarks.recommended_action_hint: Use when the projected incident or smoke corridor plausibly affects the Creston Road area.

nearby_operational_landmarks.name: Adventist Health Twin Cities
nearby_operational_landmarks.recommended_action_hint: Treat as a medical continuity and smoke-sensitive facility only when the incident is plausibly moving toward Templeton or affecting regional access.

authorities_and_contacts.name: Emergency services
authorities_and_contacts.usage_rule: Use for immediate danger to life, animals, structures, or property.

authorities_and_contacts.name: Templeton Fire & Emergency Services
authorities_and_contacts.availability: 24/7 staffed emergency services reported by the district
authorities_and_contacts.usage_rule: Use as the local fire department business/station contact. For an active emergency, call 911.

authorities_and_contacts.name: CAL FIRE / San Luis Obispo County Fire
authorities_and_contacts.usage_rule: Use for county fire coordination or non-emergency contact; use 911 for an active emergency.

authorities_and_contacts.name: San Luis Obispo County Office of Emergency Services
authorities_and_contacts.usage_rule: Use for emergency-management coordination, preparedness, public warning context, and AlertSLO information.

authorities_and_contacts.name: San Luis Obispo County Sheriff — Templeton station
authorities_and_contacts.usage_rule: Use for non-emergency law-enforcement support, access control, or road/security coordination. Use 911 for immediate danger.

authorities_and_contacts.name: Gold Medal Equestrian / Gina Miles
authorities_and_contacts.usage_rule: Primary customer contact for the demo when the incident threatens the equestrian facility, horses, ranch structures, or access routes.

demo_fictional_contacts.name: Evan Brooks
demo_fictional_contacts.usage_rule: Demo-only contact for gate access, trailer staging, horse count, and staff coordination.

demo_fictional_contacts.name: Maya Chen
demo_fictional_contacts.usage_rule: Demo-only contact when smoke or fire approaches vineyard blocks, workers, equipment, or the east access road.

demo_fictional_contacts.name: Daniel Ruiz
demo_fictional_contacts.usage_rule: Demo-only contact when the projected incident is near the residence or its evacuation route.

demo_fictional_contacts.name: Sophie Bennett
demo_fictional_contacts.usage_rule: Demo-only contact for simulated trailer mobilization and animal relocation support.

operational_assets_and_dependencies.risk: smoke exposure, panic, delayed loading, fencing constraints
operational_assets_and_dependencies.action_hint: Prepare halters, lead ropes, identification, destination, handlers, and trailers early.

operational_assets_and_dependencies.risk: blocked access, insufficient turnaround space, congestion
operational_assets_and_dependencies.action_hint: Keep Concho Way and internal gates clear; stage vehicles facing outward when escalation begins.

operational_assets_and_dependencies.asset: hay, bedding, feed, and barn materials
operational_assets_and_dependencies.risk: high combustible load and prolonged smoldering
operational_assets_and_dependencies.action_hint: Treat smoke or heat near storage as high urgency and report it explicitly.
Ask the site operator to confirm accessible water points without blocking responders.

operational_assets_and_dependencies.risk: camera or gate loss during outage
operational_assets_and_dependencies.action_hint: Maintain a phone-based fallback contact tree and manual gate access plan.

first_message_style: state the affected place or asset
offer one concrete communication or coordination action
include_in_first_message_when_available: nearest operational place or image zone
whether horses, structures, road access, school, or hospital are in the risk direction

risk_rules.effect: critical urgency; contact site operator and prepare animal relocation
raise urgency and recommend immediate site coordination
raise urgency and suggest relevant official contact
monitor and verify before broad notification
the assistant may simulate sending a message or placing a call and record the intended recipient and message

message_requirements: state fire or smoke and the nearest operational location
avoid unsupported certainty about exact spread

recommended_first_message_examples: Hanging Tree 1 detected smoke near the Gold Medal Equestrian ranch area, moving toward the barns. Should I call the site operator and start the horse-relocation contact tree?
Possible fire detected on North Hill. The current risk direction is toward ranch structures and Concho Way. Should I notify Templeton Fire and the ranch operations manager?
Smoke was detected near the Farm House zone. Should I message the property contact and keep the access road clear for responders?
A distant smoke plume is visible beyond the residence zone. It is not yet near the ranch, but it is growing. Should I continue monitoring and prepare a status update?
Smoke may affect the Creston Road corridor. Should I prepare notifications for the relevant school contact and local authority?

implementation_notes.preferred_loading: Load this JSON as optional operational context in the Live Ops incident context builder.
implementation_notes.fallback_behavior: If missing, continue using camera mapping configuration, zones, reference points, detections, and weather.
implementation_notes.separate_markdown_context: Use the companion Markdown file for human-readable and LLM-readable context. Deterministic code should read this JSON.
implementation_notes.geometry_source_of_truth: The uploaded camera mapping configuration remains the source of truth for camera coordinates, reference points, and image-zone polygons.
